description.narrative:
The general objective of the contribution is to ensure that efforts to enhance the implementation of the new National Watershed Plan PPRH increase the possibility that watershed planning will lead to on-the-ground changes that improve sustainable management of natural resources and living conditions for disadvantaged communities within Bolivian watersheds.
The proposed activities have been organized around the three pillars of the PPRH, being also directly linked to Sweden current co-leadership of the Watershed RoundTable (four pillars) and five specific objectives. - Specific Objective 1: Support Sweden in its co-leadership function of the Watershed Coordination Roundtable and the Technical Assistane Rountable SubAT. -Specific Objective 2: Respond efficiently and in a timely manner to requests from the MMAyA for capacity building on the Bolivia WATCH Toolbox as an input to efforts to effectively and productively implement the PPRH. - Specific Objective 3: Design a Finance Unit within the MMAyA to identify promising intervention opportunities prioritized in prior PDCs and future Water Planning Strategy for a Watershed. (EPHICs in Spanish according to the new PPRH) and to move these interventions towards funding and implementation based on knowledge of and experience with the full range of potential sources of funding. - Specific Objective 4: Collaborate with international agencies participating in the Watershed Coordination Roundtable in ensure the delivery of at least two productive investments in watersheds where PDCs were developed during Bolivian Watch Phase 1 - Specific Objective 5: Continue to build the case, through a cross-cutting approach to program implementation, that explicit integration of sustainable sanitation approaches, as well as gender and poverty considerations. The main pillars are i) Pillar 0: Support to Swedish Embassy and VRHR, ii) Pillar 1. Efficient, effective, and participatory governance, with a focus on gender and social equity, iii) Pillar 2. Digital management with knowledge, science, and technology and iv) Pillar 3. Productive investments

The WATCH II Program aims at supporting i) the operationalization of the PRRH, and ii) the strategic role that Sweden will play as coleader of the Watershed Roundtable. The proposed activities have been organized around the three pillars of the National Watershed Plan, being also directly linked to Sweden’s current co-leadership of the Watershed Roundtable. The plan is based on using the watershed as a frame for planning and decision making to promote improved water resource management through citizen participation leading to enhanced climate resilience and better access to basic public services. The main objective of the Program is oriented to ensure that efforts to enhance the implementation of the new Watershed Plan increase the possibility that watershed planning will lead to on-the-ground changes that improve sustainable management of natural resources and living conditions for disadvantaged communities within a watershed.

WATCH II-programmet syftar till att stödja i) operationaliseringen av PRRH, och ii) den strategiska roll som Sverige kommer att spela som en part i det delade ledarskapet för det s.k Watershed Roundtable. De föreslagna aktiviteterna har organiserats kring de tre pelarna i den nationella vattenfördelningsplanen, som också direkt kopplat till Sveriges nuvarande del i ledarskapet av Watershed Roundtable. Den bygger på att använda vattenanvändning som en ram för planering och beslutsfattande för att främja förbättrad vattenresursförvaltning genom folkligt deltagande vilket leder till ökad klimatmotståndskraft och tillgång till grundläggande samhällstjänster och service. Programmets huvudmål är inriktat på att säkerställa att insatser för att förbättra genomförandet av den nya vattenfördelningsplanen ökar möjligheten för planering av vattenanvändning vilket leder till förändringar på plats som förbättrar en hållbar förvaltning av naturresurser och levnadsvillkoren för de grupper i samhället som är missgynnade vad avser tillgång till och användning av vatten.

sector.narrative: Water sector policy and administrative management

title.narrative: Grant Agreement between The Swedish International Development Cooperation Agency, Sida and Stiftelsen The Stockholm Environment Institute regarding Bolivia WATCH 2023-2025

description.narrative:
Main Results per component achieved until now. Pillar 0. Support to the Embassy of Sweden in its role as Coleader of the Watershed Roundtable - Revision and adjustment of the new watershed instrument (the water planning strategy in basins (EPHIC in spanish). - Support in the development of the new watershed planning guidelines in coordination with the Technical Assistance round table. It includes a methodology for the transition from Watershed Master Plans to EPHIC. - Revision and Adjustment of the new National Watershed Plan "PPRH" (Review, validation and adjustment of the PPRH Performance Monitoring and Evaluation System and discussion of the inclusion of new indicators) - Technical and territorial analysis of the interventions of the different international cooperation agencies/multilateral bank to harmonize actions and investments in the territory (mapping of International Cooperation financing)
Pillar 1. Efficient and Participatory Governance (Capacity Building Platforms) - "Observatorio del Agua" platform was developed using the ArcGIS Experience Builder tool. This platform allows the construction of highly responsive, interactive web experiences without the need for programming, and it can be accessed across multiple devices. The platform includes applications for 2D and 3D maps, text, and media, enabling the focus on a single type of content or the combination and linking of different content types to create a comprehensive experience for diverse audiences regarding watershed management. -Pillar 2. Capacity Building and Scientific Knowledge Management - Training course to transfer of the Water Balance from SEI to the Viceministry of Watershed and Irrigation "VRHR" and the General Directorate of Planning of MMAyA (DGP). This has included training in use and solvency in WEAP and its respective anchoring in the Watershed Observatory (on going process) - Climate Risk Modelling: This study aims to better understand the implications of extreme events and climate variations on public policy responses to address disaster risk management and climate change adaptation. Currently it is in his final phase, expecting a final approval from MMAyA
Pillar 3: PDC watershed / Investments - Identification of potential preinvestment projects in the portfolios of Watershed Master Plans, including potential (multilateral) financiers (for Tupiza and Potosí). 6 projects have been identified in Tupiza and Potosi and currently will be presented to MMAyA for their financing.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
